body.statement:
Put \(D=Sd\).  For each fixed nonempty independent-calendar class \(\mathcal M_{N,T,\mathbf n}^{\dagger,\mathrm{iid}}(\lambda)\) with \(B>D^2\), along every array with \(N\wedge T\wedge\min_s n_s\to\infty\), uniformly for almost every admissible realized path \(z_0\in\mathcal Z_+\), there are constants \(0<c_{>}<C_{>}<\infty\), allowed to depend on the fixed slack \(B-D^2\), such that
\[
c_{>}R_\star\le
\inf_{\widetilde\tau}\sup_{P\in\mathcal M_{N,T,\mathbf n}^{\dagger,\mathrm{iid}}(\lambda)}
\mathbb E_P[(\widetilde\tau-\tau_n(z_0))^2\mid E_0]
\le
\sup_{P\in\mathcal M_{N,T,\mathbf n}^{\dagger,\mathrm{iid}}(\lambda)}
\mathbb E_P[(\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{iid}}-\tau_n(z_0))^2\mid E_0]
\le C_{>}R_\star.
\]
At \(B=D^2\), there are independently quantified constants \(0<c_{=}<C_{=}<\infty\) such that the same iid-tuned estimator has risk at most \(C_{=}R_\star\), while the universal lower bound is \(c_{=}(R_{\mathrm{tr}}\vee R_{\mathrm{sm}}\vee R_{\mathrm{sp}})\); no donor converse is asserted.  At \(B<D^2\) the class is empty.  Thus conditional calendar independence removes the logarithm from the spacing channel without changing the treated, smoothing, or generated-donor terms.
body.proof_tex:
Apply the two-point squared-error argument in equation \((6)\) to the four iid pairs in \texttt{lem:iid-joint-law-embedding}.  This gives the \(R_\star\) lower bound under strict slack.  At equality apply it to exactly the three available non-donor pairs, yielding the stated boundary lower bound.

For the upper bound, repeat decomposition \((7)\) for \(\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{iid}}\).  Equations \((8)\), based only on full-design centering, cross-unit independence, boundedness, and deterministic local-polynomial weights, are unchanged.  The iid selector moment with exponent \(2\lambda\) replaces (9) by
\[
\mathbb E[B_{\mathrm{LP}}^2\mathbf1_{\mathrm{good,iid}}\mid E_0]
\le C\{R_{\mathrm{sm}}+T^{-2\lambda/d}+N^{-\lambda}\}
\le CR_\star.
\]
The donor calculation (10)--(11) is unchanged because the same full donor mean and projection are used, and it gives \(CN^{-\kappa}\).  The iid selector bad-event probability is \(O(R_\star)\), while the error is uniformly bounded there.  Squaring the four-term decomposition gives the upper bound.  The estimator is observed-data measurable and does not use \(\Sigma\), completing the minimax bracket and boundary qualification.

The strict-slack constants \(c_{>},C_{>}\) are obtained from the four-channel interior construction and may depend on \(B-D^2\).  The equality-boundary constants \(c_{=},C_{=}\) are obtained separately from the three boundary pairs and the common upper-bound argument; they are quantified independently and inherit no dependence on the zero slack.
body.justification: The iid-tuned full-donor estimator attains \(R_\star\), and channelwise causal embeddings match it under strict slack.
body.gap: Conditional calendar independence is stronger than geometric beta mixing.
body.consumer: It turns the former no-log comparator into a joint-panel statistical result.
